paragraphs: The GLK200 uses the M271 — a 1.8-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted throughout the X204 generation's entire production run, from 2008 to 2015. The GLK200 sat as the entry-level petrol option in the GLK-Class range, offering a more accessible alternative to the larger GLK250 and GLK350 petrol variants. The GLK-Class was discontinued in 2015 and succeeded by the GLC, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLK200 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLK200 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
